# Copilot Instructions

This repository is a Markdown-first research diary.

## Rules
- Keep chronology centered in `weeks/YYYY/MON_WEEKn.md`.
- Avoid day-level diary structures.
- Use external links for code repositories and W&B dashboards.
- Do not copy machine-generated logs into markdown notes.
- Keep front matter small and consistent with templates.
- Keep weekly entries concise: what was done, links, and what is next.
